findings.ensemble_effect: T ensemble is below four individual seeds but within the five-seed range. Full-window ensemble volatility exceeds all five seed values and matches independently reconstructed actual selection returns.

interpretation: No implementation or aggregation error found. T deterioration spans all five seeds and cannot be attributed only to seed42 or ensemble averaging.
